newsitem.title: USA: Colgate Q3 gross profit margin higher.
newsitem.headline: Colgate Q3 gross profit margin higher.

text.p: Colgate-Palmolive Co said Thursday its gross profit margin increased more than a full percentage point in the third quarter, allowing it to increase "significantly" its spending on advertising around the world.
The company said it had a sharp increase in earnings to record levels, and a decrease in overhead expenses despite the rise in advertising spending.
"Volume growth in the developing world was strong, but we are particularly encouraged with the excellent shipment increases in our North American and European businesses," it said.
The company said unit volume grew 5.0 percent in North America and 4.0 percent in Europe in the third quarter.
"With this momentum and our aggressive on-going new products program, Colgate is well positioned for a strong fourth quarter and 1997," it said.
The company said unit volume growth reached 8.0 percent in Latin America, while sales went up 9.0 percent.
It said its Hill's Pet Nutrition unit grew 11 percent in global sales on 6.0 percent unit volume growth.
"Hill's continues to lead the specialty food segment in the U.S. and globally," it said.
Colgate-Palmolive makes products for oral care, personal care, household care, fabric care and pet nutrition.
